Same station grouping, but the overall average comes from the observatories table joined to telescopes, so stations with no telescopes are excluded or included differently.
Same station grouping, but the overall average is computed over signals joined to telescopes, so each telescope is weighted by its number of signals (a signal-level average).
Station averages computed over telescopes that have at least one signal (inner join to signals), with the overall average over the same joined set.
Same as the others, but "above" is strict (>) versus at-or-above (>=).
The margin is the absolute difference (station avg − overall avg), versus a percentage excess ((station avg − overall avg) / overall avg × 100).
Return the top 10 stations by margin, descending, with ties broken arbitrarily.
Return the top 10 stations by margin, descending, with ties broken by station name.
Return the top 10 stations by margin, descending, including all tied stations at the 10th position.

The overall average excludes the station being compared (leave-one-out), versus including it.
The station average is computed as a sum divided by a count of non-null rows, which gives the same result as AVG. It is different if integer or rounded intermediate values are used.

Station names are compared after trimming whitespace or normalizing case, since `observstation` is CHAR(60), so padded or differently-cased names are grouped together, versus grouped as exact strings.

The top 10 is chosen by the absolute margin, versus the signed margin. The two differ only if below-average stations were included, which the "above" filter already excludes.
queries:
SELECT observstation,
       AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg_bandusagepct,
       (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) AS overall_avg_bandusagepct,
       AVG(bandusagepct) - (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) AS diff_from_overall
FROM telescopes
GROUP BY observstation;
SELECT AVG(station_avg) AS overall_avg_snr
FROM (
  SELECT t.observstation, AVG(s.snrratio) AS station_avg
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  GROUP BY t.observstation
);
SELECT o.observstation
FROM observatories o
JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
GROUP BY o.observstation
HAVING AVG(o.airtempc) > (
  SELECT AVG(o2.airtempc)
  FROM observatories o2
  JOIN telescopes t2 ON t2.observstation = o2.observstation
);
SELECT t.observstation,
       AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg_bandusagepct,
       (SELECT AVG(t2.bandusagepct)
        FROM signals s
        JOIN telescopes t2 ON s.telescref = t2.telescregistry) AS overall_avg_bandusagepct
FROM telescopes t
GROUP BY t.observstation;
SELECT t.observstation,
       AVG(t.pointaccarc) AS avg_pointaccarc,
       AVG(t.trackaccarc) AS avg_trackaccarc,
       (SELECT AVG(t2.pointaccarc) FROM telescopes t2 JOIN signals s2 ON s2.telescref = t2.telescregistry) AS overall_avg_pointaccarc,
       (SELECT AVG(t2.trackaccarc) FROM telescopes t2 JOIN signals s2 ON s2.telescref = t2.telescregistry) AS overall_avg_trackaccarc
FROM telescopes t
JOIN signals s ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
GROUP BY t.observstation;
